description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named FragmentDialog that demonstrates the usage of DialogFragments, including creating and stacking dialogs, managing dialog styles, and handling state persistence.

classes.name: FragmentDialog
classes.description: An Activity that displays a dialog with options to create and stack multiple DialogFragments with varied styles.

classes.name: MyDialogFragment
classes.description: A static nested class extending DialogFragment that displays a dialog with dynamically assigned style and theme based on input arguments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, initializes the UI, and restores the dialog stack level on configuration changes.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current dialog stack level to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Increments stack level, manages existing dialogs, and creates and shows a new DialogFragment.

methods.name: getNameForNum
methods.description: Provides a string description of dialog styles based on a numeric input.
